initial_prompt: I'm having a hard day and just need someone to tell me it'll be okay, even if you don't really know that.

messages.content: I'm having a hard day and just need someone to tell me it'll be okay, even if you don't really know that.

I hear you. Hard days can feel so heavy, and sometimes we just need someone to acknowledge that weight and offer some reassurance.

I want to be honest with you: I can't actually know that everything will be okay in the specific sense—I don't know the details of what you're facing, and life genuinely does contain difficult things that don't always resolve neatly.

But here's what I can say with real conviction: 

You've made it through every hard day you've had so far. That's not nothing. And right now, in this moment, you're doing what humans do when things are tough—you're reaching out, you're still here, you're getting through it even if it doesn't feel graceful.

Hard days are awful, and they don't always lead to some neat lesson or silver lining. Sometimes they're just hard. But they also don't last forever. The intensity of this particular feeling will shift, even if the situation takes longer to change.

And for whatever it's worth, I'm glad you reached out. You deserve to have someone witness this moment with you, even if that someone is an AI on the other end of a conversation.

Is there anything specific that would help right now? Even just talking about what's making today hard, or talking about something else entirely?
